verdict.rationale: TeamViewer's pricing page lists "Enhanced mass deployment (MSI)" as a feature, so the product itself claims MSI-based fleet deployment. That claim is a single pricing-line mention with no supporting deployment documentation. The mobile device management item (docs-9) covers managing mobile devices, not deploying the TeamViewer client via MDM, so it earns no credit here. missing for 10: documented preset/custom configuration at deploy time, MDM-based client deployment, documented silent-install switches or parameters, in-depth deployment docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an IT admin, I can mass-deploy the client with preset configuration through MSI, MDM, or a documented silent install
